Checkbox

Checkboxes allow users to select one or more options from a set. They are commonly used for settings, permissions, and agreements.

Basic Checkbox

Simple checkbox with label.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="checkbox" id="terms" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="terms">I agree to the terms and conditions</label>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="checkbox" id="newsletter" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox">
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="newsletter">Subscribe to newsletter</label>
</div>

Checked & Disabled States

Checkboxes can be checked, unchecked, or disabled.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="checkbox" id="checked" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="checked">Checked checkbox</label>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="checkbox" id="disabled" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox" disabled>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="disabled">Disabled checkbox</label>
</div>

Inline Checkboxes

Display checkboxes horizontally.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-check-inline">
  <div class="zak-form-check">
    <input type="checkbox" id="red" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox" checked>
    <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="red">Red</label>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-check">
    <input type="checkbox" id="green" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox">
    <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="green">Green</label>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-form-check">
    <input type="checkbox" id="blue" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox">
    <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="blue">Blue</label>
  </div>
</div>

Card Checkbox

Checkbox styled as a selectable card for richer UI.

HTML 
<div class="zak-card-checkbox-row">
  <label class="zak-card-checkbox">
    <input type="checkbox" name="plan" value="free" checked>
    <div class="zak-card zak-card-bordered">
      <div class="zak-card-body">
        <strong>Free Plan</strong>
        <span class="zak-form-text">$0/month - 1 project</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </label>
  <label class="zak-card-checkbox">
    <input type="checkbox" name="plan" value="pro">
    <div class="zak-card zak-card-bordered">
      <div class="zak-card-body">
        <strong>Pro Plan</strong>
        <span class="zak-form-text">$29/month - 10 projects</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </label>
</div>

Custom Styled Checkbox

Checkboxes with custom colors and styles.

HTML 
<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="checkbox" id="success" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox zak-checkbox-success" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="success">Success checkbox</label>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-check">
  <input type="checkbox" id="danger" class="zak-form-check-input zak-checkbox zak-checkbox-danger" checked>
  <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="danger">Danger checkbox</label>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-form-checkCheck container
.zak-form-check-inputBase checkbox/radio input
.zak-form-check-labelLabel for checkbox
.zak-checkboxCheckbox specific styling
.zak-form-check-inlineInline layout
.zak-card-checkboxCard-style checkbox
.zak-checkbox-successSuccess color
.zak-checkbox-dangerDanger color
.zak-checkbox-warningWarning color

Accessibility

  • Each checkbox must have an associated <label> via for/id.
  • Use aria-checked="true" for custom-styled checkboxes that use role="checkbox".
  • Group related checkboxes with role="group" and aria-labelledby.
  • Disabled checkboxes should have aria-disabled="true".
  • Ensure visible focus indicators on keyboard navigation.
